correctness.rationale: In the repaired odd case, the columns are I+Sᵀ up to scaling and centering. Odd alternating closure makes this incidence map invertible, so the hull is a simplex in 1⊥. The normalized facet height opposite vertex i is 1−n, with all other heights 1 by centering. The scaled normal (α/2)w alternates between −(n−1)/2 and (n+1)/2 with multiplicities (n+1)/2 and (n−1)/2, hence the exact norm squared (n−1)²(n+1). The normal sum vanishes under cyclic shifts. Summing the equal-norm inequalities proves the global bound attained at zero, and spanning forces the center to be zero at the bound. Undoing the scale α/2 gives 2/√(n(n²−1)) for the standard edge polytope.
